IPFIX
Description
The IPFIX namespace deals with commands and events for the IPFIX
protocol.
Command List
IPFIX::destination
- open and close
IPFIX logging destinations
IPFIX::msg
- create, delete and set data
values in an IPFIX message based on the provided IPFIX_TEMPLATE.
IPFIX::template
- create and delete
user defined IPFIX message templates
